title: How Going to Bed on Time Makes a Godly Man Harder to Tempt
caption:
Most nights lost to the phone were lost at 10 PM, when you were already tired and still awake. Set the stop time, move the phone, end with a Psalm. Rest is part of self-control.

Try it tonight.

#faith #godlyman #selfcontrol #sleep #christianmen
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
